attempts.cause: The margin_pct function incorrectly calls margin_pct recursively instead of selecting the margin_pct column from item_margins_v.

The margin_pct function is returning the margin percentage calculated based on the average unit cost, but the failing tests suggest that the margin calculation in item_margins_v is incorrect when multiple deliveries are involved, likely because average_unit_cost is not correctly reflecting the weighted average cost across all deliveries for the purpose of margin calculation in the report.
